story.title: Ripple's RLUSD Surpasses $2 Billion Milestone Amid XRP Buzz
story.usedTitleNorm: ripple s rlusd surpasses 2 billion milestone amid xrp buzz

tr.title: Ripple's stablecoin exceeds two billion dollar market cap
slides: Ripple's stablecoin RLUSD has crossed the two billion dollar milestone.
It reached this level within two years after its launch.
Nearly half of the market cap is now on the XRP Ledger.
The growth highlights increasing demand for stablecoins on the XRP ecosystem.
tr.caption:
Ripple's stablecoin has surpassed a two billion dollar market cap.
The token is now available on the XRP Ledger for almost half of its supply.

#Crypto #Stablecoin #XRP
